Definition: Chammon, the name of two places in Palestine
BiblicalUsage: Hammon is the name of two towns, and Scripture keeps them apart by their tribes. One stands in Asher near great Zidon, and the other in Naphtali was given to the Levites out of the half tribe of Manasseh.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe two towns sharing a name is a reminder to read the map, not just the word: the same warm springs can water two different inheritances.
